items.title: investingLive Americas FX news wrap 25 Nov: It’s a Wrap. S&P 500 and Nasdaq pare steep losses
items.summary: U.S. stocks close mixed as Dow reverses a 1,105-point drop The Nasdaq looked over the edge. Support held. Now what? Beige Book: Eight of 12 districts report growth as wage pressures pick up Baker Hughes US rig count holds steady at 607. Oil rigs rise by one. Trump blames the election for the selloff. Here’s what I’m watching.
